item.title: Lang scores 1,000th point, leads Collinsville boys past Spring Garden
item.description: Staff Reports COLLINSVILLE — Gavin Lang netted 17 points and eclipsed the 1,000 point barrier for his career in leading the Collinsville Panthers past Spring Garden 57-41 in basketball action on Saturday. Sylas Adams added 14 points. Sam Stewart finished with 12 points for Collinsville (9-3). Collinsville hosts Geraldine on Tuesday.
